name: 寬幅影片卡片＋四角分散的標題、說明與按鈕
desc: 左右留邊的寬幅圓角卡片，背景是填滿卡片的影片；標題組在左上，一句說明文字在左下，外框按鈕在右下，中間留大片空白。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊是卡片，左右兩側留邊；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角。卡片為寬幅橫式，高度約為寬度的四成，卡片背景是填滿卡片的影片，文字與按鈕都疊在影片上。卡片內左上方放標題（可多行），標題下方可放小標籤，沒有時省略；標題中等大小，約佔卡片寬度的一成多。卡片內左下方放一句說明文字，右下方放一顆按鈕，按鈕與說明文字約在同一高度，沒有時省略；卡片中段留大片空白，內容分成上下兩群。
mobile: 卡片仍左右留邊、四角圓角，比例改為接近方形、略呈直式。標題組維持在左上方，說明文字維持在左下方；右下方的按鈕隱藏不顯示。影片背景保留。

en.name: Wide video card + heading, description and button spread to the corners
en.desc: A wide rounded card with side margins and a video filling its background; the heading group sits top-left, a single line of description bottom-left, and an outlined button bottom-right, with generous empty space in between.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section is a card with margins on the left and right; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) are rounded corners. The card is wide and landscape, with a height of about four tenths of its width, and its background is a video that fills the card, with the text and button placed over the video. In the top-left area of the card, place a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label below it; omit it when there is no content. The title is medium-sized, taking a little over one tenth of the card's width. In the bottom-left area of the card, place a single description, and in the bottom-right area place a button at about the same height as the description; omit it when there is no content. Leave generous empty space in the middle of the card, so the content is split into an upper group and a lower group.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The card keeps its left and right margins and all four rounded corners, and its proportions change to nearly square, slightly portrait. The heading group stays at the top left and the description stays at the bottom left; the button at the bottom right is hidden. The video background is kept.
